name: word diff over words, spaces and punctuation, with the middle snake fixing which comma matches
why: Words: a = [foo ( bar , ' ' 2 )], b = [foo ( baz , 2 )]. Prefix [foo (] and suffix [2 )] are stripped, leaving [bar , ' '] vs [baz ,]: delta 1 (odd), and the forward pass at d = 2 on diagonal 0 slides over the comma and overlaps the backward frontier, so the comma is the middle snake. Left [bar] vs [baz] becomes delete bar, insert baz; right [' '] vs [] deletes the space. That is 3 edits, the minimum: 3 + 2 - 2 x LCS(1).
